name: REDCap RAG AI Chatbot
description: Prototype module for REDCap-RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) AI Integration. Currently working towards using OpenAI to allow users to integrate external knowledge bases (i.e. Files inside REDCap folders) during the response generation process.

sub_settings.name:
REDCap Folder
(External source) to utilize to generate response

REDCap Field (Optional)
REDCap descriptive fields after which REDCap AI Chatbot suppose to appear on Data entry and Survey page

Greeting message to display inside a chat window when opened
If empty, it will default to "Hi there How can I help you today?"
sub_settings.default: Hi there How can I help you today?

sub_settings.name:
[Important] System Prompt: Starting text of instruction.
(If empty, it will default to "You are an assistant which answers questions based on knowledge which is provided to you. You provide accurate and concise answers. While answering, you don't use your internal knowledge, but solely the information in the uploaded files. You don't mention any reference of files in response.")
Note: This is important part so be careful while changing this. You can add instruction on weather to restrict search for uploaded files or not by entering appropriate prompt.
sub_settings.default: You are an assistant which answers questions based on knowledge which is provided to you. You provide accurate and concise answers. While answering, you don't use your internal knowledge, but solely the information in the uploaded files. You don't mention any reference of files in response.

sub_settings.name:
Text to prepend to a question (Optional).
(Example: "Reformulate the response as plain text only. Do not use Markdown, bolding, italics, or headings.")

Custom message to display in response if answer is not a part of any files
If empty, it will default to "Sorry, We are unable to provide any information based on this question.".
sub_settings.default: Sorry, We are unable to provide any information based on this question.

sub_settings.name:
Temperature
Default: 0.5, Value should be between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

Max Num Results
Default: 4, The maximum number of results to return. This number should be between 1 and 50 inclusive.

Score Threshold
Default: 0.8, Value should be a number between 0 and 1. Numbers closer to 1 will attempt to return only the most relevant results, but may return fewer results.

Max Output Tokens
Default: 4000, An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a response, including visible output tokens and reasoning tokens.
